weeks.content:
Write one word for many letters
ant, ball, cup, dog

I can run. The sun is up.
Copy with finger spaces

I am a boy or girl. I am five.
Write about myself

Write numbers in rows of ten
Fill missing numbers

Copy the seven days
Say them in order

Copy the twelve months
Find my birthday month

Copy my house address with help
Know why address matters

Write one sentence about my friend
Capital letter and full stop

Copy two lines without mistakes
Check my work

Write our best page
Every child gets a writing star
